items.headline: No Big Ten football teams in AP top 5 for first time since '21
items.description: A weekend of Big Ten upsets left the conference without a team in the top 5 of the AP Top 25 college football poll for the first time since 2021.

items.headline: AP college football Week 12 poll reaction: What's next for Top 25
items.description: A look at the AP rankings, along with a key stat and what's ahead for each team.

items.headline: Chaos takes over the Big Ten: UCLA, Indiana and Ohio State all lose in Week 12
items.description: UCLA, Indiana and Ohio State all lost to unranked teams in a year where parity is the ever-present theme.

items.headline: Dissecting playoff predictor and College Football Playoff chances
items.description: Dari Nowkhah, Chris Doering and Benjamin Watson dive into the Allstate Playoff Predictor and break it down to SEC contender probabilities as they analyze the current standings.

items.headline: Which teams have the best odds to make the College Football Playoff?
items.description: We are tracking the odds for making the CFP, earning a bye and winning it all.

items.headline: Austin Simmons throws 4 TD passes, leading Missouri past No. 17 Kentucky 28-14
items.description: — Austin Simmons threw for 314 yards and four touchdowns, Donovan Olugbode caught five passes for 105 yards and two of the scores, and Missouri beat No. 17 Kentucky 28-14 on Saturday night.
